text.en: Galactica is row 108 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the AI4Science area.
text.zh: Galactica 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 108 行，所属领域为“AI for Science”。

text.en: The annual table associates Galactica with “Galactica: A Large Language Model for Science”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Galactica 与论文《Galactica: A Large Language Model for Science》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Ross Taylor, Robert Stojnic”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Ross Taylor（官方页拼写）、Robert Stojnic（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Ross Taylor, Robert Stojnic”。
